notes:
Calorie Monitor 0.3.0

What's new
- Colour palettes: pick Baldosa, Añil, Botella, Almagre or Grafito.
- Two-step verification: set it up with a QR code, keep recovery codes, enter a code at sign-in.
- Forgot your password? Reset it from the sign-in screen, and verify your email from the app.
- Redesigned sign-in, sign-up and profile screens.
- New versions are announced even with the app closed.
- Workouts: a 2D muscle map in the exercise editor, a calendar that marks your training days, sessions that prefill, pull to refresh, and machines with their brand. Machine notes are now kept per user.
- Allergens are detected from the ingredients, whether scanned, typed or from OpenFoodFacts.
- Tea bag servings, scaled to the amount of water.
- Recipes: reorder the photos and choose the cover; recipe photos now sync to the server.
- Edit or remove a habitual meal from its sheet.
- Macro bars: drag to reorder, and many bars collapse neatly.
- A sync badge on everything that syncs.

Improvements
- Faster and lighter app, with smoother scrolling in the food list.
- Label scanning reads real labels better: more languages, columns and net weight, and ingredient lists no longer pick up nutrition table rows.
- Reminders can run in the background, so battery savers don't hold them back.
- Background sync waits until the battery is not low.
- A smoother price chart, and value per € counts the whole pack.

Fixes
- The server is no longer shown as offline when it is up.
- Rows the server lost are recreated or cleaned up instead of getting stuck.
- Swipe actions no longer fire during fast scrolls.
- A recipe whose photo no longer exists says so.
- Scanning a barcode while editing a food works, the serving can be changed when editing an entry, and the undo message can be dismissed.
- Your diary is kept out of device backups, and personal data out of logs.
- Many smaller interface fixes on the home screen.
